totalyield.config.title: Total Yield Settings
totalyield.config.default_display.toolti:
What to show on the crafting result slot normally.
 
VANILLA: Do not show anything extra. The slot looks exactly as it does without this mod.
EXACT: Show the total number of items you can craft with your current ingredients.
STACKS: Show the total as a stack expression using your chosen format.
totalyield.config.shift_display.tooltip:
What to show on the crafting result slot while Shift is held.
This always overrides the Default Display setting when Shift is held.
 
EXACT: Show the total number of items you can craft.
STACKS: Show the total as a stack expression using your chosen format.
totalyield.config.stack_format.tooltip:
The format used when the display mode is set to STACKS.
 
MULTIPLIER: Shows stacks using x as a separator.
SHORTHAND: Shows stacks using s as a suffix.
GROUPED: Shows stacks with the stack size in parentheses.
totalyield.config.animation_enabled.tool: When enabled, the yield number plays a pop animation each time it appears or its value changes.
